description: This Java class represents an event called AclModified, which is emitted after a Thing's Access Control List (ACL) has been modified. It includes functionality for constructing instances from parameters or JSON, serializing to JSON, and managing event metadata such as revision, timestamp, headers, and metadata. The class is marked as deprecated, indicating that it is part of an older API version.

classes.name: AclModified
